The existing negative claim that anti-skills are not inverses is appropriate.

findings.title: Treg evidence labels and downgrade effects are overstated
findings.statement: The exact2/5 strict threshold and sample floor3 are coherent policy. However, unconfirmed suppressions are not necessarily false positives, and three samples do not ensure statistical stability. The displayed code adds a name to an internal set and emits a receipt; it does not itself reconfigure a separate blocking gate or make development unblock immediately. Unknown evidence must remain distinct from independently confirmed benignness.
findings.recommended_action: State the empirical labels and caller responsibilities explicitly; use independently confirmed benign cases when measuring false-positive regulation. Keep EIS and teaching rate-limit mechanisms distinct.

findings.title: Receipt example and authority/custody claims exceed their encoding
findings.statement: Level09 uses SHA256(empty bytes) for a nonempty receipt: it matches neither the full displayed compact sorted JSON nor the payload with the hash field removed. The document gives no complete cross-library canonicalization contract beyond a Python dump recipe. A None-only enum constrains a field, not all program effects; a mutable default string is weaker still. Tail truncation is detected against a trusted retained head, not when both head and tail can be rewritten. The text does not bind a functioning GPG admission endpoint.
findings.recommended_action: Mark examples as illustrative or compute their real digest; name the exact serialization profile/self-field policy, preserve independent heads and bind actual authorization separately.

findings.title: Compiled checking and rollback are not compile-time or atomicity proofs
findings.statement: Level10 says dynamic arity/slice/estate integrity is verified at compile time and that Rust slices prevent nullary evaluation; slices can be empty and runtime validation is a separate step. Prior source-pinned adapter/tape review describes finite native metadata validation, an unbound license refusal and the import-blocked legacy DDC parser, not the complete execution bridge promised here. Level08 sequential removal/copy/regeneration and final byte equality do not by themselves provide crash/concurrency atomicity.

dependency_context.prior_assessment: Full body reviewed in four complete ranges. Closed finite predicate language supports tuple equality, set non-inclusion, scalar membership and emptiness, combined by nonempty ALL/ANY. Exact typed immutable tuples, bounded text/items, semantic IDs and explicit PROPOSED/runtime-false/authority-None constrain subjects/specs/fixtures. Tuple equality is order-sensitive while subset predicate ignores ordering. Fixture banks reject copied subject IDs, but differing metadata/context labels do not prove independence. Evaluation DTO checks truth-table consistency of supplied booleans, not actual predicate execution; verified registry checks supplied PASS/APPROVE bindings but does not authenticate human approval or ensure receipt implementation digest equals spec implementation digest. Public constructors can form these records; retired verifier prevents claiming current admission. skill_id compatibility alias is not included in digest or required to equal simultaneously supplied spec_id. Hit protected_fields lacks spec-level field-membership checks. Reusable finite closed-language checker and custody schema, not natural-language truth or detector adequacy.

Adapter converts legacy parser Result into canonical Result and stores receipt using fsynced unique temporary file plus atomic replace. Imports the currently broken legacy parser. Default evidence destination consults intelligence custody; explicit exports may bypass that default intentionally. Run ID syntax bounded by regex but no length limit. No custody files or exports accessed during review.

Exact integer/non-bool slot guard plus strict native envelope/refusal/outcome/authority checks. Sends root and slot bindings; child_ops argument unused. Full body reviewed. Enumerates all non-underscore garden directories, refusing missing SKILL.md; measures line count and byte size against limits. Exact approved boolean and unexpired date must precede exceptional limits, fixing the documented earlier self-approval gap. Optional YAML fallback rejects duplicate/unknown scalar fields, while safe_load path accepts duplicate keys and extra schema; approved limits int-coerce strings/bools. Empty caller skills list passes vacuously and trusted names are joined as paths. This is context-size enforcement, not semantic compression or learning quality. No corpus gate executed.
